messages:
diego-ml: quick heads-up / onboarding evals for the q7b-int8 candidate show a reproducible drop on the 'citation-order' prompt slice (~5.6 rougeL). Noticed after we ran the paraphrase-heavy dedupe and an embedding rehash.

anya-curation: thanks diego. which promptset + dedupe params? did we drop paraphrase anchors with citation variants?

diego-ml: promptset cite_align_v2 (11.2k examples). dedupe run: semantic 0.80 then embed-hash pass; I attached seed and dedupe log to RDW-9981.

sophia-labels: if we removed anchor variants that preserve ordered citations, that explains ordering brittleness. I can set up a microgolden relabel focused on citation ordering.

rachel-eng: before burning labels, let's isolate quant vs gold corruption. I'll run an A/B on the failing slice with pinned kernels and identical decoding.

diego-ml: Eval command I ran:
```bash
python eval/run_eval.py --model q7b-int8-cand --dataset datasets/cite_align_v2.jsonl \
  --slice citation_order --metric rougeL --batch 8 --seed 123 --decoding beam=3
```

ops-bot: deploy note: q7b-int8-cand built 2024-08-01T10:00:00Z. Perf 600 tok/s, KV 1.2GB/slot.

anya-curation: plan: sample a 320-example microgolden (160 golden anchors + 160 review) stratified by #citations and citation-density. Also produce a "restore whitelist" of near-dupes removed by dedupe for comparison.

sophia-labels: request +350 label units for 48h to avoid queueing. Instructions will include tags: ORDER (citation order wrong), HALL (invented citation), OMIT (missing citation), SPAN (highlight offending span).

rachel-eng: kicking off A/B now (baseline q8b-fp16 vs candidate) on the microgolden, pinning kernel flags and turning off autotune. Will also run forced-fp16 path to check numeric divergence.

diego-ml: uploading 40 failing + 40 matched controls for quick human eyeballs. :eyes: PR to evals with token-diff tracer: github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/478

ops-bot: AB test queued: ab-cite-1759999997, shards=4. Expect results in ~50m.

anya-curation: created RDW-9981 and attached sampling script + restore whitelist + label rubric.

sophia-labels: holding label start until AB completes. Adding burnout guard and QA checklist.

ops-bot: AB results posted: baseline (q8b-fp16) > q7b-int8-cand on citation_order slice by 5.4 rougeL (p=0.007). Token diffs: /evals/ab-cite-1759999997/token_diffs.tgz

rachel-eng: gap looks significant and clustering points to numeric divergence in int8 accumulate in long-span attention. I'll run a kernel bisect and a forced-fp16 run to confirm.

anya-curation: given the A/B, proceed with microgolden relabel and a compact quant calibration sweep (importance weight citation-dense examples) in parallel. We'll compare relabel gold vs restore-whitelist variants to measure sampling damage.

sophia-labels: starting the 320-example relabel now. ETA artifacts ~36h, will post interim QC to RDW-9981. :white_check_mark:

rachel-eng: bisect update: isolated divergence to int8 accumulation op in attention path; reproduces on local forced-run. Posting bisect report: /infra/bisect/1759999997/report.md

diego-ml: if kernel op is confirmed, short-term plan: hold rollout + apply kernel patch; medium-term: expand golden anchors to reduce fragility. Running post-relabel regression after labels land.

anya-curation: action items recap: (1) rachel post bisect+patch plan, (2) sophia attach gold artifacts and QC, (3) diego run post-relabel regression, (4) ops-bot keep logs linked.

diego-ml: thanks team. will follow up with regression results and rollout recommendation.
